storage: Your workspace could not save or load this change. Check available disk space and try again.
not_found: This item is no longer available. Refresh the page to see the current workspace.
validation: Some information is missing or invalid. Check the values and try again.
conflict: The workspace changed while this was running. Refresh and review the latest version before continuing.
untested: This app still needs testing and preview approval before it can be published.
read_only: This action tried to change data while running in read-only mode. The app needs a correction.
cancelled: Work stopped. Previously saved progress is kept.
deadline: This app action took too long. Saved progress is kept; review its outcome before trying again.
limit: This request exceeded a workspace safety limit. Your draft is kept; reduce its size or split the work into smaller steps.
saturated: The workspace is busy. Please try again shortly.
script: The app encountered a problem in its code. Ask the assistant to inspect the diagnostics and fix it.
missing_secret: An integration credential is missing. Add the required secret in Settings.
network: The server could not reach an external service. Saved work is kept; check the connection and continue when it returns.
external_uncertain: An external operation may have completed. Review its effect evidence before another attempt; it will not be repeated automatically.
duplicate_invocation: This operation was already started. Check its existing result instead of submitting it again.
approval_required: This change needs your approval before it can proceed.
unauthorized: Sign in to your workspace again. Saved work is kept.
shared_chatgpt_connection: This test workspace shares its ChatGPT connection. Manage that connection in the main workspace’s Settings.
model: ChatGPT returned an unexpected response. Saved work is kept; you can continue from the last checkpoint.
authentication: Reconnect ChatGPT in Settings, then continue the saved job.
browser_unavailable: Automated browser verification is unavailable. Review the isolated preview before publishing.
model_catalog_limit: ChatGPT returned an unusually large model catalog. Your message draft is kept. Retry model loading or reconnect ChatGPT.
usage_limit: A ChatGPT usage limit has been reached for this app or account. Check Usage in Settings and continue when it is available again.
usage_unavailable: ChatGPT plan usage is unavailable for this account or workspace. Check your plan and workspace settings.
model_incomplete: ChatGPT did not finish its response. No tools from that response were run. Saved progress is kept.
model_timeout: ChatGPT stopped sending data for too long. Saved progress is kept; continue from the last checkpoint.
stream_interrupted: The connection to ChatGPT ended before its reply finished. Saved work is kept; no tools from the unfinished response were run.
login_throttled: Too many sign-in attempts from this connection. Wait five minutes before trying again.
rate_limited: ChatGPT is temporarily limiting requests. Wait a little, then continue the saved job.
provider_unavailable: ChatGPT is temporarily unavailable. Your progress is saved; continue when the service returns.
provider_access: Your account or workspace does not permit this request. Check ChatGPT access in Settings.
provider_request: ChatGPT could not accept this request. Your progress is saved; the app or model configuration needs attention.
model_unavailable: This model is unavailable for your account. Choose an available model for a new message.
context_limit: This conversation has grown too large for another model request. Your app and saved work are kept; start a new build conversation.
content_blocked: ChatGPT could not complete this request because of its content restrictions. Revise the request.
recovery_required: The server stopped during an action whose outcome is unknown. Review the app and any external effects before requesting further changes. That action will not be repeated automatically.
job_budget: This job reached its step budget. Progress is saved; choose Continue to allow another block of work.
interrupted: The server stopped before this older job had a recoverable checkpoint. Saved work is kept; send a new message to continue.
model_event_limit: ChatGPT sent a response event larger than this app can safely read (4 MiB). The partial reply and saved work are kept; no tools from that response were run.
model_output_limit: ChatGPT produced more output than this app can safely retain. The partial reply and saved work are kept; no tools from that response were run.
tool_loop: The build stopped after repeatedly reading unchanged data. Your draft is saved. Continue saved work to retry.
